doc.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Golson never paired Fuller with Art Farmer; 11 Golson discs
summary: Listening to a reissue, Fuller notes Golson never made a two-horn record with Art Farmer yet used him on 11 discs.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: I’m trying to see who it is. Oh, yeah, this is the one with Thad Jones.
I mean, half of that… The double set is a re-issue of "The Imagination.” The other part is your first recording with them.

See, I'd like to spend a little time doing this again. That's Sonny Redd. Did you know, out of all the indifferences we had with Benny and myself, you know how many times he did the two horned things with Art Farmer in his career?
You told me they never did it
I know, I was going to see if you knew of one.

Whenever Art Farmer used another guy, he used Clifford Jordan. Benny, every time he recorded used me on 11 different discs. Still, there is that on easy thing, that underlying thing that I don't understand so I leave it alone. I never understood that. But, it's coming, it's coming. Anyway, I have enjoyed the fact that I got a chance to play with not everybody but just about every mainstream porn
